name: IndoStar Capital Finance Limited
summary: IndoStar Capital Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides various financing services in India. The company offers vehicle finance products for new and used commercial vehicles, including medium and heavy commercial vehicles, light commercial vehicles, intermediate commercial vehicles, small commercial vehicles, pick-ups, and buses; new and used passenger vehicles; new and used construction equipment; and new and used farm equipment. It also distributes life, motor, and health insurance products.
